shared_elements: upright slab-shaped surface carved with a designed field
framing border enclosing a decorated panel
registers or stacked zones of ornament
justification: Both are upright slabs bearing a framed, vertically stacked composition combining schematic upright figures with circular/ring motifs and curving arcs, and both use flat, outlined, non-naturalistic figural conventions without modelling or perspective. But B depicts a specific narrative-looking scene of a row of cloaked, hooded figures in profile under an arch with an interlace border, whereas A's content reads as isolated abstract emblems (a large concentric ring, curved bands) with only vague figural elements at the top and no comparable procession or interlace framing.
